title: Introducing Cricut AutoPress™ 2 – 12 x 12: Hands-Free Pressing Made Easy
summary: Meet Cricut AutoPress 2 12x12, with hands-free Auto Mode, 110 lb pressure, four presets, and guided settings for HTV, sublimation, and DTF.

# Introducing Cricut AutoPress™ 2 – 12 x 12: Hands-Free Pressing Made Easy


-
-
-


16 October 2026


[Cricut](https://cricut.com/blog/author/cricut/)


---


If you love creating personalized projects and want to spend less time and effort pressing projects, we’ve got you covered.


Meet Cricut AutoPress 2 – 12 x 12, the newest size in the Cricut AutoPress lineup. Designed to keep it simple, this 12 in x 12 in heat press brings the convenience of automatic pressing to standard-size projects in a simplified format.


Featuring hands-free Auto Mode with Zero Effort™ operation, 110 lbs of consistent automatic pressure, even edge-to-edge heat, built-in presets, and interactive Heat Guide through Design Space® connectivity*, Cricut AutoPress™ 2 – 12 x 12 makes it easy to get consistent results.


Whether you’re personalizing shirts, making totes, creating home decor, or producing projects for a small business, it’s an automatic heat press designed to deliver pro-quality results.


## Hands-free pressing made simple


With Cricut AutoPress 2 – 12 x 12, Auto Mode makes creating in batches easy.


Place your project on the heat plate, push in the tray, and let Auto Mode with Zero Effort™ operation take over. The press automatically applies 110 lbs of consistent pressure and releases when the pressing cycle is complete.


That means less manual effort and a more streamlined workflow — especially when you’re making multiple projects. From a stack of personalized T-shirts to a batch of matching totes, Cricut AutoPress 2 – 12 x 12 helps you maintain a consistent, repeatable process every time you press.


## Consistent heat and pressure for lasting results


Getting reliable heat transfer results depends on consistent heat and pressure.


Cricut AutoPress 2 – 12 x 12 delivers consistent 110 lbs of pressure across the pressing area, so you don’t have to manually adjust pressure from project to project. The heat plate provides dry, even, edge-to-edge heat up to 410°F (210°C) for successful heat transfers projects.


The result is a simple heat pressing experience designed to help take the guesswork out of pressing.


## Four presets and simplified controls


Simple doesn’t mean limited. Cricut AutoPress 2 – 12 x 12 features four built-in customizable presets, making it easy to save frequently used time and temperature combinations for the projects you make most.


Integrated controls on top of the heat press put key settings right where you need them, while Bluetooth® connectivity to our Design Space app* helps keep your press connected to the Cricut ecosystem.


For additional guidance, use the[interactive Heat Guide](https://cricut.com/heatguide) in Design Space* to find recommended time, temperature, and pressure settings for compatible materials and projects. Whether you’re working with HTV,[sub](https://cricut.com/blog/sublimation-and-infusible-ink-with-cricut/)[l](https://cricut.com/blog/sublimation-and-infusible-ink-with-cricut/)[imation](https://cricut.com/blog/sublimation-and-infusible-ink-with-cricut/) , or DTF Transfers, step-by-step guidance in the interactive Heat Guide helps simplify the guesswork process for pro-quality results.


## Interactive Heat Guide in Design Space


Cricut AutoPress 2 – 12 x 12 connects to the interactive Heat Guide in the Design Space app, providing you and your heat press the time and temperature settings for compatible materials and projects, as well as step-by-step guidance. You can also send precise temperature and time settings directly to your heat press from the app.


### How it works


1. Choose your heat-transfer materials and base
2. Send the settings directly to your heat press via Bluetooth®
3. Get step-by-step guidance for a simple pressing experience


## What can you make with this automatic 12 in x 12 in heat press?


Cricut AutoPress 2 – 12 x 12 has a versatile heat press size for many everyday personalization projects like:


- T-shirts and other apparel
- Tote bags
- Pillow shams
- Home decor
- Compatible[DTF transfer projects](https://cricut.com/blog/dtf-transfers-explained/)
- Other standard-size heat-transfer applications


The slide-out tray accommodates materials up to 1.8 inches thick, giving you flexibility to work with a range of blanks.


And if you’re working with DTF transfers, Cricut AutoPress 2 – 12 x 12 provides the even heat and consistent pressure needed for successful application. Always follow the recommended time, temperature, and pressure settings for your specific project.


## Cricut AutoPress 2 – 12 x 12 vs. Cricut AutoPress 2 – 15 x 15: Which size fits your projects?


Cricut AutoPress 2 – 12 x 12 and Cricut AutoPress 2 – 15 x 15 share the same core automatic pressing experience, but they’re designed with different kinds of projects in mind.


Cricut AutoPress 2 – 12 x 12 is designed to keep automatic pressing simple. The 12 in x 12 in heat plate provides ample space for standard-size projects, while 110 lbs of consistent pressure means there’s no need to adjust pressure between projects.


[Cricut AutoPress 2 – 15 x 15](https://cricut.com/blog/introducing-cricut-autopress-2/) provides a larger 15 in x 15 in heat plate and adjustable pressure from 45 to 220 lbs. The larger plate size and adjustable pressure control is useful for larger projects, making in multiples, and working with materials that call for specific pressure settings.

In short, choose Cricut AutoPress – 12 x 12 for a simple, straightforward automatic pressing experience, and consider Cricut AutoPress – 15 x 15 when you need a larger pressing area and greater pressure control.


## How does Cricut AutoPress 2 – 12 x 12 compare to Cricut EasyPress™ heat presses?


Both Cricut AutoPress 2 – 12 x 12 and Cricut EasyPress heat presses are designed to make heat transfer projects more approachable, but they offer different pressing experiences.


With a Cricut EasyPress heat press, you manually apply pressure while pressing your project, and the compact size makes it easy to store. Cricut AutoPress 2 – 12 x 12 automates the pressing process and applies consistent 110 lbs of pressure.


Cricut AutoPress 2 – 12 x 12 is particularly useful if you frequently make multiple projects and want a more hands-free workflow. Instead of holding the press down throughout the cycle, you can let the automatic pressing process do the work.


The right heat press depends on how you like to make, and the types of projects you typically create.


## Who is Cricut AutoPress 2 – 12 x 12 for?


Cricut AutoPress 2 – 12 x 12 is designed for makers who want the convenience of an automatic heat press with consistent pressure.


It’s a great fit for:


- Makers who want hands-free pressing
- Crafters creating standard-size apparel and home decor
- People who frequently make multiple projects
- Makers looking for a straightforward 12 in x 12 in heat press
- Small businesses producing personalized items like shirts and totes
- Anyone who wants consistent pressure without manually adjusting it


If your projects are generally standard-size and you value a simple workflow, the 12 in x 12 in format provides an automatic pressing experience in a size designed to keep things simple.


For larger designs, higher-volume production, or projects that benefit from adjustable pressure, Cricut AutoPress 2 – 15 x 15 offers a larger heat plate and adjustable pressure control.


## Where to buy Cricut AutoPress 2 – 12 x 12


Cricut AutoPress 2 – 12 x 12 is available in[Powder Blue](https://cricut.com/en-us/heat-presses/cricut-autopress/cricut-autopress-2---12-x-12/cricut-autopress-2---12-x-12-powder-blue/2013279.html) and[Lavender](https://cricut.com/en-us/heat-presses/cricut-autopress/cricut-autopress-2---12-x-12/cricut-autopress-2---12-x-12-lavender/2013280.html) at[cricut.com](https://cricut.com/en-us/discover-heat-presses) , Amazon, and major retailers, subject to availability.


When choosing where to purchase, check the listing to confirm the exact size, bundle contents, and included accessories.
